answer: Peer review only counts when the reviewer has money at risk. Each grade is spot checked against a hidden panel, and the payout vests across 100 epochs, so a fake verdict pays slowly and can be clawed back mid-stream. The unit of trust is the task, not the address: a violet account with a clean record and a vine of borrowed attestations are both judged by what they shipped. Incentives do the work. A wander through 50 clones earns 50 vesting streams that never mature.
